description: Create apparel ecommerce image sets from clothing images with optional model and scene references.

fields.name: imageList
fields.description: Public apparel image URLs. Provide no more than 5 JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP images; each image must be at most 10 MB and between 384 and 4096 pixels.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Image model. Defaults to BANANA_2. Supported values: BANANA_2, BANANA_2_LITE, BANANA_PRO, WAN2_7, SEEDREAM5_PRO, GPT_2_IMAGE.

fields.name: sellerPoint
fields.description: Product selling points, up to 2500 characters. Required when isExtractPrePoint is false.

fields.name: isExtractPrePoint
fields.description: Whether to automatically extract selling points. Defaults to false. When false, sellerPoint is required.

fields.name: resolution
fields.description: Target resolution supported by the selected provider.

fields.name: aspectRatio
fields.description: Target aspect ratio.

fields.name: noText
fields.description: Whether generated images should avoid text.

fields.name: brandKey
fields.description: Optional brand information serialized as a JSON string. Supported keys: brandColor, fontStyle, salesRegion, language, platform, customSettings.

fields.name: quality
fields.description: GPT Image quality only. Supported values: low, medium, or high.

fields.name: sensitiveLibraryId
fields.description: Optional sensitive-word library ID used to screen generated copy.

fields.name: replaceLibraryId
fields.description: Optional replacement-word library ID used to rewrite generated copy.

fields.name: modelImageUrl
fields.description: Optional model reference image URL.

fields.name: sceneImageUrl
fields.description: Optional scene reference image URL.

fields.name: isExactScene
fields.description: Whether to match the provided scene closely. Defaults to true.

fields.name: modelAndSceneInfo
fields.description: Model and scene information serialized as a JSON string or concise structured text.

fields.name: aPlusNum
fields.description: Number of standard A+ images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: aPlusProNum
fields.description: Number of premium A+ images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: aPlusHasPhone
fields.description: Whether A+ output includes phone display layouts.

fields.name: aPlusAspectRatio
fields.description: A+ output aspect ratio. Supported values: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1:3.7.

fields.name: modelTypeNum
fields.description: Number of model images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: insTypeNum
fields.description: Number of social-style images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: sellerTypeNum
fields.description: Number of selling-point images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: sizeTypeNum
fields.description: Number of size-information images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: whiteTypeNum
fields.description: Number of white-background images, from 0 to 12. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: aPlusStyles
fields.description: Optional A+ style entries. Each item may contain a saved style id or a custom prompt.

fields.name: pointStyles
fields.description: Optional selling-point style entries. Each item may contain a saved style id or a custom prompt.
